text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a spectacle so breathtakingly vivid, it made me forget to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As Fuji Kiseki dashed across the turf giving her all, the stands welcomed her with earth-shattering applause.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! That was amazing!
It was a fantastic race!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, magnificent~!
You're so magnificent, Lord Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the wonderful show!
*sniff*

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "—Thousands of spectators held their breath, waiting for her single word."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With every single breath, with every single move she made,
thousands of spectators were captivated by the dream.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text: "I want you, and only you, to burn my image into your memory. With those pitch-black eyes of yours...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAAHH--!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...That's... that scenery...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (...Stay calm. A true entertainer sees it through to the end...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki closed her eyes and offered an elegant bow.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—To receive such a loving standing ovation,
I am beyond honored.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And with this, the challenge of this year's Senior Class draws to a close. The time has come for the performer to return backstage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Still, fret not!
My story does not end here!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Fuji Kiseki spread her arms wide――
fireworks filled the sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And beyond that, the continuation of today!
I swear I will deliver it to you...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
goodbye and farewell!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the radiant sky behind her, everyone gazed
at the smiling Fuji Kiseki with longing in their eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That marks the end of Chapter 1, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
She didn't take first place.
Yet, there wasn't a single trace of disappointment in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Everyone... was enjoying my challenge.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right now, that makes me happier than anything.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The red glow of the evening sun
slowly illuminated Fuji Kiseki's profile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This is my path—no, this is where I belong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I could say anything, she turned on her heel and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Now then, I can't stay lost in sentimentality forever!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
An ending is just a new beginning. We still have
places to go! Let's move, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If it's us, I'm sure we can go anywhere.
